summary: The right lung, near-completely opacified in the prior, shows improved aeration and visible vasculature through the mid and lower zones on the current image.

findings.rationale: Prior right hemithorax (image-left, matched by rib/hilar alignment) shows dense confluent opacification from mid to lower zone; current image shows the same region with visible bronchovascular markings and reduced density, consistent with improving edema/effusion rather than technical exposure difference, since the contralateral lung and mediastinal position are stable.
